title: Star AI Researcher Is Leaving Meta
summary: Andrew Tulloch,  the star AI researcher who was offered a pay package worth more than $1 billion to join  Meta Platforms  last year, is leaving the company, according to people familiar with the situation.  Tulloch’s hiring was a coup for Meta and capped a frantic recruiting spree last summer, when Meta threw money at researchers to try to catch up in the race to build artificial intelligence.
